messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Dashboard totals differ from exported figures, causing finance to doubt the numbers.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "date": "2026-10-27T11:53:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Finance keeps questioning the numbers because the dashboard totals don’t match the export figures mismatch — I’ve re-exported three times and it’s consistent with UTC cutoff, not UK time.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-11T13:36:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Finance is questioning which figure is correct because the export doesn’t match the dashboard — the export figures mismatch is causing delays in our month-end close.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-19T11:36:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Lastly, our finance team’s pulling their hair out — the dashboard totals don’t match the CSV exports, causing export figures mismatch headaches.",
   "route": "account_management"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-14T11:53:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Yes — we’re getting pushback from our finance team because the report totals differ between the dashboard and the exported file. It’s causing some trust ...",
   "route": "account_management"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-15T11:14:00Z",
   "quote": "our finance team’s been flagging that the export figures mismatch with dashboard totals — it’s causing real delays because they can’t trust which numbers to use for month-end reporting",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-16T09:43:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Also, our finance team’s noticed the report totals differ — they’re comparing dashboard numbers with exported files and getting confused.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-15T10:17:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Finance keeps comparing the MI dashboard totals with the CSV export and finds them off—this export figures mismatch is causing distrust in the numbers they use for monthly reporting.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-04T10:05:00Z",
   "quote": "Reports: click \"Export CSV\", error exception... Claims: click \"Save\"",
   "route": "sessions"
  }
 ],
 "title": "Dashboard totals differ from exported figures, causing finance to doubt the numbers."
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the claim that dashboard totals differ from exported CSV figures. Multiple quotes across support, account management, and sales routes consistently report the same product discrepancy, with one quote suggesting a timezone (UTC vs UK time) cutoff inconsistency in the product's reporting logic. This is an internal data-consistency issue a squad could investigate and fix; it is not pricing, customer IT, or praise, and no help article would resolve a genuine mismatch in the product's own numbers.", "verdict": "pass"}
